title: An External Fairness Evaluation of LinkedIn Talent Search
reasoning: The paper is an empirical fairness audit of a proprietary ranking system (LinkedIn Talent Search). While it uses an LLM as a tool to generate test queries, it does not study or evaluate LLMs themselves, nor does it address bias within LLMs specifically. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness regarding gender and race, and it does not contain a component evaluating religion, faith, or broader philosophical ethics.
